title: Initial and rendered canonical signals disagree
scope: Fictional saved HTML and DOM snapshots only

evidence.observation: Initial snapshot declares canonical A; provided rendered snapshot declares canonical B.
evidence.method: Fictional paired-snapshot inspection; not a live site test

mechanism: Contradictory canonical signals make the intended representative unclear. This does not prove the Google-selected canonical.
recommendation: Establish the correct representative, then propose a consistent initial/rendered implementation.

acceptance_tests.test: Compare the live initial response and actual rendered DOM after authorised deployment.

limitations: No live deployment, browser session or Google inspection was performed.
